name: collapsible-06
description: Mobile checkout order summary that shows the total in the trigger and reveals line items.

files.content:
import { ChevronDownIcon, PackageIcon, ShoppingBagIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/collapsible" import { Separator } from "@workspace/ui/components/separator" const items = [ { name: "Linen overshirt", qty: 1, price: 89 }, { name: "Merino crew socks", qty: 3, price: 14 }, { name: "Canvas tote", qty: 1, price: 32 }, ] export default function CheckoutOrderSummary() { const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty * item.price, 0) const shipping = 6 return ( Show order summary ${subtotal + shipping}.00 } />
{items.map((item) => (
{item.qty}
{item.name} ${item.qty * item.price}.00
))}
Subtotal ${subtotal}.00
Shipping ${shipping}.00
) }
